list: The official 55 trophies, as published on PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (reported by Push Square, 18 November 2026). 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden; all single-player, no online trophies.
notes: Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones. Every guide below is written in our own words for this entry and names its sources beside it; no guide text is copied from any source. Where a trophy's exact steps were still unconfirmed at launch, the guide says so instead of guessing.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Budget around 200 hours — most of that time is the 100% checklist behind A Long Road, not the story. Everything is single-player and there are no online trophies, so the whole list can be done in one playthrough.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, one of the first missions of Chapter 1. It is unmissable and pops as the story moves on.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to the end. The trophy can pop when the first mission of Chapter 2 starts, so keep playing past the final cutscene instead of quitting out.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2; the trophy lands as Chapter 3 begins, after the Welcome to Vice City mission.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3; the trophy arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. It cannot be missed — it pops for completing the chapter.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the last mission of the story. Free roam carries on after the credits, so you can clean up everything else on this list afterwards. There is no mission replay and no trophy depends on how you play a mission, so keep a manual save from just before the finale in case you want a clean run at it.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 story mission. It is unmissable and pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission. It is unmissable and pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play, a Chapter 4 story mission. It is unmissable and pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete Headliners, a Chapter 4 story mission. It is unmissable and pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 story mission. It is unmissable and pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 story mission. It is unmissable and pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — work you did earlier still counts. The checklist asks for every robbery, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks, plus a share of the rest: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Nothing on the checklist is missable; expect roughly 100 hours for this stage alone.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land any 250 stunts. There are 397 on offer: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the fastest way to build the count, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not required. Track the total under Progress, Activities, Stunts; the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race) and a stunt. Progress, Activities shows what is left. Most of these come naturally while you play.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds across 12 ranges. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger, so do them before you chase that one.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finish each location properly while you are there.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available. Winning the same race again does not count, so keep moving to races you have not won yet.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game. Three of them — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — are on the TV at home, and the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. Do all five in order — Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the last one awards the trophy. They stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton (green KR icon in Key Lento) hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig it up. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so you can finish it then. Track it under Progress, Collections, Kenton's Treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The fifth, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy. They stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed, so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. None of them are needed for 100%, and all stay available after the story. Do Yago's Race Against Yago the moment it appears — it is time-sensitive, marked with an hourglass icon, so save first and then race.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best places to look. Cars in better condition pay more.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Once enough are gone, his last job (Shut Down the Labs) awards the trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every Meditation Spot until the counter reaches 18; meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, so bring your partner every time. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. The last one needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet; the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets — you do not need all of them. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 / RB). Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; Progress, Challenges marks finished ones with a tick. Many complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this one comes along the way.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once both characters are together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y), get a 4-star Wanted Level and escape — it only counts once you are out of the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you are still wanted (flashing red and blue). Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) are close together. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app — you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you will get this anyway.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming. Take down 5 enemies in a single use — it only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first (eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer) and use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport; the trophy is delayed, so keep flying. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County — the tanks are parked at the south end of the base. Get in and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 gives you the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is. Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. Five of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault (see Maximum Withdrawal) counts, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or get to a Pay 'n' Spray. Before vaults open, you can box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch until the map is fully revealed.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs; Progress, Gangs keeps count. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this one pops along the way.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City. The exact steps are not confirmed yet at launch — GTA Base lists this one as unconfirmed, so treat any specific bar or seat you read about as unverified until players confirm it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom. The exact steps are not confirmed yet at launch — GTA Base lists this one as unconfirmed, so do not chase a specific showroom until players confirm one.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back, so grab them together if you can.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason and Lucia, Strength in the pause menu). Work out at fitness clubs (Map, Activities) with your partner along: training one trains the other too. After the story you can also train at home. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players get it without trying — robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up as you play. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI to watch the count. Do not push towards the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: "Second time's the charm" suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. The exact steps are not confirmed yet at launch — GTA Base lists this one as unconfirmed, so do not chase a specific method until players confirm one.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Expect a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida. The exact steps are not confirmed yet at launch — GTA Base lists this one as unconfirmed, so keep an eye out while exploring rather than hunting a specific spot.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle — a melee drive-by. The exact steps are not confirmed yet at launch — GTA Base lists this one as unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is a running total, so the robberies for 100% get you there.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: A running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
